methodContext.assayUnitDefinition: Enzyme amount catalyzing micromoles of galacturonic acid per minute under the assay conditions (Methods 2.2); not a fermentation production rate.

ssfExtractionProtocol.scope: Nominal extraction method. Extraction rpm is not culture rpm; g is not rpm; added water is not measured recovered liquid.

limits: Table 3 has no published SD and no table-specific n; Methods 2.16 declares three parallel replicates at article scope.
Table 4 SD applies to U/mL means, not its percentages. Biological/extraction/technical replicate identities remain unknown.
Table 4 culture time is unreported here; 37 C follows explicit Methods 2.9 and Results 3.5 linkage.
Tables 3/4 do not restate a complete recipe, pH, inoculum, vessel or source dry-mass basis; corresponding case fields remain null.
Two Table 3 modes each have their own 100% denominator. Neither Table 4 nor an extraction-water volume supplies the missing absolute activities.
Question 9 also asks broader differences, advantages/disadvantages and food examples; this activity is a partial design capability.
Study observations do not identify a universal mode effect, oxygen-only mechanism, process yield, cost, smell or learning outcome.
